content: Let the line L be the projection of the line $${{x - 1} \over 2} = {{y - 3} \over 1} = {{z - 4} \over 2}$$ in the plane x $$-$$ 2y $$-$$ z = 3. If d is the distance of the point (0, 0, 6) from L, then d<sup>2</sup> is equal to _______________.
